The '''iron sword''' is a low-level [[weapon]] made of [[iron equipment|iron]], stronger than the [[bronze sword]]. It can be purchased from [[Varrock Swordshop]] or made at level 19 [[Smithing]] with 1 [[iron bar]], granting 25 experience.
